detail.longDescription: The LiteLLM 1.107.0 backdoor started with one GET to an agent-listing endpoint. A master key exposed in May was never revoked. On Oct 10, /api/v1/managed_agents/agents returned every agent's config, including a GitHub org owner's CLI OAuth token. On Oct 21 that token disabled branch protection. 91 minutes later, poisoned wheels hit PyPI. https:// docs.litellm.ai/blog/security- incident-oct-21-2026-attack-chain # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # SupplyChain # Python
